answer: A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Pedicab driver licence works as the check: a licence the transport authority renews after ridden fare years. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The atlas record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the harbor entry is checkable by anyone, and the mirror window closes before a farm can catch up.
